articles.summary: – Contracted Forward Sales Increase 26% from Q2’26 to $3.0 billion 1 at the Segment Level – – Management Targets Approximately $1.6 Billion of Value from Turtle Creek Within 24 Months – TERRE HAUTE, Ind., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Hallador Energy Company (Nasdaq: HNRG) (“Hallador” or the “Company”) today reported its financial and operating results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Company is also providing an update on Turtle Creek Gas (“Turtle Creek”), its approximately 460-megawatt natural gas-fired generation project at the Merom site, which the Company is advancing toward a final investment decision (“FID”) targeted before the end of 2026. “Our goal at Turtle Creek is to seek to roughly double an $800 million investment into $1.6 billion of value over the next 24 months,” said Brent Bilsland, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. “We believe the market ascribes little to no value to the project today.
